name.ja: 非滑らか点・分岐・停止条件の微分範囲
name.en: Derivative scope at kinks, branches and stopping decisions

caption.ja: 保存した非滑らか関数値と停止写像、古典微分が未定義な点とtrace微分を分けた表示。 図の座標は有限次元の変数・反復・診断で、物理空間の次元やPDE境界を表しません。
caption.en: Saved nonsmooth values and stopped-map samples, distinguishing undefined classical derivatives from trace derivatives. Plot axes describe finite-dimensional variables, iterations or diagnostics, not a physical spatial dimension or PDE boundary.

name.ja: 有限次元非線形写像・根と微分作用
name.en: Finite-dimensional nonlinear maps, roots and differential actions

note.ja: 有限の代数写像に対する根・JVP/VJP・HVP・分岐規約です。nは空間次元ではなく変数数で、非滑らか点に古典微分を強制しません。
note.en: Roots, JVP/VJP, HVP and branch conventions for finite algebraic maps. The variable count n is not a spatial dimension, and a classical derivative is not imposed at nonsmooth points.

equation_note.ja: 小さな固定入力・実数・無次元。詳しい入力と適用範囲は対応する契約に限定します。
equation_note.en: Small fixed real dimensionless inputs; assumptions and scope are limited to the matching contract.

name.ja: 非滑らか点・分岐・停止条件の微分範囲
name.en: Derivative scope at kinks, branches and stopping decisions

note.ja: 古典微分・一方向微分・実行trace微分を、kinkと停止分岐の固定例で区別します。
note.en: Distinguish classical, one-sided directional and executed-trace derivatives at fixed kinks and stopping switches.

title.ja: 非滑らかな離散写像：一方向微分と実行trace
title.en: Nonsmooth discrete maps: directional derivatives and executed traces

assumptions.ja: abs・ReLU・clip・多項式分岐の固定7点と方向±1を用います。停止反復はx0=0、更新前に|xk−θ|≤1/8を検査し最大5更新。θ=1/4,1/2,1は切替点です。
assumptions.en: Use seven fixed points and directions ±1 for abs, ReLU, clip and a polynomial branch. The stopped iteration starts at x0 = 0, tests |xk - theta| <= 1/8 before updating and allows at mostfive updates. Theta 1/4, 1/2 and 1 are switching points.

note.ja: 選択した分岐の微分は普遍的なsubgradientや非滑らかな写像の線形微分ではありません。
note.en: An executed-branch derivative is not a universal subgradient or a linear derivative of a nonsmooth map.

reference_note.ja: 固定入力・独立参照・保存候補・全判定を同じ120秒予算内で検証します。数値合格と診断用非収束を区別します。
reference_note.en: Check fixed inputs, independent references, retained candidates and every gate within the same120-second budget. Numerical success and diagnostic nonconvergence are distinct.

method_note.ja: strict nondifferentiableを明示し、停止前<=判定の実行分岐だけを記録します。
method_note.en: Report strict nondifferentiability explicitly and record the literal top-of-loop stopping branch.
